name: What Kills Elias
source:
Mystical serial murders and a severe psychological crisis push Elias toward a dark choice. A neighbor’s dog is disturbing a teen, and his family is being followed by a suspicious man.

Elias intends to “solve” the problem… But at what cost?

[From [url=https://halkind.itch.io/what-kills-elias]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
神秘的连环谋杀案和严重的心理危机迫使埃利亚斯做出了黑暗的选择。邻居的狗骚扰了一名青少年，而他的家人则被一名可疑男子跟踪。

埃利亚斯打算“解决”这个问题……但代价是什么？

[来自[url=https://halkind.itch.io/what-kills-elias]Itch.io[/url]]
